name: Dexter
description: Dexter Morgan, a blood spatter pattern analyst for the Miami Metro Police also leads a secret life as a serial killer, hunting down criminals who have slipped through the cracks of justice.

videos.title: Early Cuts: Alex Timmons (Chapter 1)
videos.overview: Dexter hunts Alex Timmons, a corrupt Gulf War veteran who used the cover of war to kill the innocent.

videos.title: Early Cuts: Alex Timmons (Chapter 2)
videos.overview: Dexter sets his crosshairs on a marine sniper.

videos.title: Early Cuts: Alex Timmons (Chapter 3)
videos.overview: Dexter stalks his prey.

videos.title: Early Cuts: Alex Timmons (Chapter 4)
videos.overview: Dexter takes a trophy.

videos.title: Early Cuts: Gene Marshall (Chapter 1)
videos.overview: A young Dexter encounters arsonist Gene Marshall and is forced to rethink his methods.

videos.title: Early Cuts: Gene Marshall (Chapter 2)
videos.overview: Dexter learns that Marshall's crimes basically went unpunished as he was deemed unfit for trial after he used his money to exploit the system.

videos.title: Early Cuts: Gene Marshall (Chapter 3)
videos.overview: Dexter subdues and confronts Marshall about the people who were casualties of his arsonist activities.

videos.title: Early Cuts: Gene Marshall (Chapter 4)
videos.overview: Dexter is interrupted from his ritual with Gene Marshall when his sister, Deb, insists he celebrate her sweet-sixteen birthday with her.

videos.title: Early Cuts: Cindy Landon (Chapter 1)
videos.overview: Dexter stalks a new victim and finds one in Cindy Landon, a magician's assistant with a special skill that makes her husbands disappear.

videos.title: Early Cuts: Cindy Landon (Chapter 2)
videos.overview: Cindy reveals the secrets behind her trade and speculates that her role in a magic show is more important than the magician's.

videos.title: Early Cuts: Cindy Landon (Chapter 3)
videos.overview: Dexter introduces himself to Cindy at a magic show and even though she is married she agrees to meet him later in an abandoned parking lot.

videos.title: Early Cuts: Cindy Landon (Chapter 4)
videos.overview: With Cindy subdued, Dexter sets the stage for his own magic show with her as the center of attention.

videos.title: A Sitdown with Michael C. Hall and John Lithgow
videos.overview: Aired after the finale of season 4. The shocking season 4 finale of Dexter was kept as a secret until the last minute that the cast had to scramble in the dark.

videos.title: Early Cuts: Dark Echo (Chapter 1)
videos.overview: Dark Echo tells a story in which Dexter is challenged by a copy-cat killer who does not follow any sort of code. Dark Echo opens immediately after the death of Dexter's father, Harry, with Dexter in his early twenties and his sister Debra still in high school. Dexter is enrolled in medical school where he's studying anatomy to improve his "craft." During a routine kill, Dexter realizes that another student has been spying on him and knows that he is a serial killer. He confronts the student after he begins to commit murders in Dexter's style and the two clash over the ethics of their situations.

videos.title: The Dark Defender: Little Chino
videos.overview: Watch episode one of the new online series The Dark Defender. The Dark Defender rids Miami of a notorious gang lord. Stalker of the night, his blade of vengeance turns wrong into right.

videos.title: The Dark Defender: Roger Hicks
videos.overview: Watch episode two of the new online series The Dark Defender. The Dark Defender kills a murderous car dealer. Stalker of the night, his blade of vengeance turns wrong into right.

videos.title: The Dark Defender: Ken Olson
videos.overview: Watch episode three of the online series The Dark Defender. The Dark Defender goes after a copycat killer. Stalker of the night, his blade of vengeance turns wrong into right.

videos.title: Early Cuts: All in the Family (Chapter 1)
videos.overview: Dexter hunts a new killer on New Year's Eve.

videos.title: Early Cuts: All in the Family (Chapter 2)
Early Cuts: All in the Family (Chapter 3)
videos.overview: Dexter receives some new clues in his hunt for the prostitute killer.

videos.title: Early Cuts: All in the Family (Chapter 4)
videos.overview: In Chapter 4 Dexter flashes back to a childhood incident where Deborah sensed his darkness.

videos.title: Early Cuts: All in the Family (Chapter 5)
videos.overview: Dexter's digs up some family history in his hunt for the prostitute killer. Starring Michael C Hall, written by Scott Reynolds and illustrated by David Mack.

videos.title: Early Cuts: All in the Family (Chapter 6)
videos.overview: Dexter faces off with Coleman Lindquist and his father in the final chapter of Early Cuts.

videos.title: S08E02 Wrap-Up (Directed by Michael C. Hall)
Dexter
videos.overview: Dexter Morgan, a forensics expert who leads a secret life as a killer of unconvicted criminals, is impressed by the work of a new serial killer.

videos.title: Crocodile
videos.overview: The Miami Metro Police Department investigate the murder of an undercover officer, while Dexter stalks another victim. Debra discovers a piece of evidence in the Ice Truck Killer Case that helps her get a promotion.

videos.title: Popping Cherry
videos.overview: While LaGuerta focuses the department's attention on a potential suspect in the Ice Truck Killer Case, Debra continues to look elsewhere. Doakes decides to pay a visit to drug lord.

videos.title: Let's Give the Boy a Hand
videos.overview: The Ice Truck Killer's recent crime scenes send a secret message to Dexter Morgan, and lead him to remember his past.

videos.title: Love American Style
videos.overview: The Homicide Division is buzzing after The Ice Truck Killer's latest victim is found mutilated, while Dexter stalks a murderous human trafficker.

videos.title: Return to Sender
videos.overview: The Ice Truck Killer leaves a clue at the scene where Dexter has dispatched his latest victim, and Dexter is worried that someone might have witnessed his killing. Rita is trying to deal with her ex-husband.

videos.title: Circle of Friends
videos.overview: Rita must deal with the return of her menacing, recently paroled husband, Paul Bennett. The Ice Truck Killer is supposedly identified, but Dexter is skeptical.

videos.title: Shrink Wrap
videos.overview: The strange suicide of a powerful woman leads Dexter to suspect her shrink of murder, but he gets a shock when a visit to the suspect opens up dark secrets from Dexter's past.

videos.title: Father Knows Best
videos.overview: While on a weekend getaway with Rita, his sister and her new beau, Dexter learns that his biological father, thought to be dead for 30 years, has just passed away, and that he's willed his son everything he owned.

videos.title: Seeing Red
videos.overview: Dexter Morgan is sent to investigate a blood-soaked crime scene, and is gripped by a suppressed memory. Meanwhile, Rita is charged with assaulting Paul and could lose the children in a custody battle. Angel investigates a hunch regarding The Ice Truck Killer.

videos.title: Truth Be Told
videos.overview: The Ice Truck Killer sets a trap for Dexter by kidnapping someone close to him; Dexter's increasingly odd behavior piques Doakes's interest.

videos.title: Born Free
videos.overview: Dexter figures out who the Ice Truck Killer is, along with a dark secret from his troubled past. Meanwhile, La Guerta is replaced with a new boss and Angel figures out a way how to track the killer while he's still in hospital.

videos.title: It's Alive!
videos.overview: Things are really beginning to heat up for Dexter: Doakes' suspicions about him are growing, his victims are escaping, and his body dump site has been found. Meanwhile Paul is troubling Rita over the missing shoe and Debra is going through trauma over the Ice Truck killer incident.

videos.title: Waiting to Exhale
videos.overview: Dexter is finding it hard to have closure on killing his brother. There is a new FBI agent to head the "Bay Harbor Butcher" case. Debra is finding it tough to put the past behind her.

videos.title: An Inconvenient Lie
videos.overview: Dexter's inability to deceive has him pursuing a slick liar as his next victim, while Rita believes he's concealing a drug problem and forces him into a 12-step program where he meets Lila, a seductive new woman.

videos.title: See-Through
videos.overview: Rita's estranged mother visits and senses something is wrong with Dexter. Masuka thinks he's developed a lead in the Bay Harbor Butcher case, which has Dexter concerned. Angel's interrogation of a witness crosses a line.

videos.title: The Dark Defender
videos.overview: Dexter discovers that the man who murdered his mother in front of him as a boy is still alive and confronts the killer as part of his recovery from addiction - but he also discovers that old impulses die hard.

videos.title: Dex, Lies, and Videotape
videos.overview: A copy-cat killer follows the lead of the "Bay Harbor Butcher." Dexter must destroy an incriminating surveillance video.

videos.title: That Night, a Forest Grew
videos.overview: Dexter manages to get Doakes off his back. He devises a plan to get the police in another direction. Lila and Dex's relationship intensifies, and he has some interaction with Rita and the kids.

videos.title: Morning Comes
videos.overview: Dexter is attacked by the man who murdered his mother. Meanwhile, Lila wants to get closer to Dex, and Debra and Lundy close in on the Bay Harbor Butcher.

videos.title: Resistance Is Futile
videos.overview: Dexter realizes it won't be easy to end things completely with Lila. Dexter tries to stay ahead of the investigations as the manhunt for the Bay Harbor Butcher intensifies. An enemy of Dexter figures out his secret.

videos.title: There's Something About Harry
videos.overview: Doakes follows Dexter to his next crime scene and shocks him with a revelation about Harry. The Bay Harbor Butcher task force feels they are zeroing in on their man.

videos.title: Left Turn Ahead
videos.overview: Dexter must make a massive decision that will have an effect on all those he holds close. Lila meanwhile is back with a secret to blackmail Dexter.

videos.title: The British Invasion
videos.overview: Special Agent Lundy and the FBI finally settle the case of the Bay Harbor Butcher, but the heat's not entirely off Dexter as the flames literally close in.

videos.title: Our Father
videos.overview: Dexter has put his life back together but things may fall apart soon. His new victim is also being targeted by Assistant District Attorney Miguel Prado. Deb has to decide how to handle Internal Affairs, as they want her to turn on her new partner.

videos.title: Finding Freebo
videos.overview: Debra and the homicide unit, Dexter and ADA Miguel Prado are all searching for the same serial killer, who is responsible for the death of Prado's younger brother. Meanwhile at home, Dexter is faced with a decision to make concerning Rita and her kid

videos.title: The Lion Sleeps Tonight
videos.overview: Dexter and a pedophile have a run-in; Dexter is unable to restore Freebo's good name after he is accused of a murder he didn't commit. Also, Dexter's friendship with Miguel weighs on his mind.

videos.title: All in the Family
videos.overview: After an unsuccessful marriage proposal, Dexter must convince Rita that he is looking for more than a convenient merger of finances and parenthood.

videos.title: Turning Biminese
videos.overview: Dexter hears the story of a husband who has gotten away with murdering two wives for financial gain and tracks the man to Bimini, but Rita has a medical emergency while Dexter has disappeared.

videos.title: Sí Se Puede
videos.overview: Dexter tests Miguel to see if he is on his dark-side job. Rita questions her career path after being fired from her job. Debra believes she in some way caused another homicide while working on her current case.

videos.title: Easy as Pie
videos.overview: Dexter angers Miguel Prado when he says no to his request for them to kill Ellen Wolf. Meanwhile, a deathly ill Camilla Figg asks Dexter to kill her. Anton Briggs is told that he is being used as bait to get at The Skinner.

videos.title: The Damage a Man Can Do
videos.overview: Dexter undertakes to teach Miguel Prado the Code, but doesn't realize he's whetting his thirst for blood; Debra is one step closer to finding the Skinner; Quinn reveals a secret about C.I. Anton Briggs.

videos.title: About Last Night
videos.overview: Dexter is happy to have someone to help him with his killings, but can his new accomplice really keep to the Code of Harry or will he become the very thing Dexter seeks to destroy? Rita revolves to confront Miguel about his suspected infidelity. Debra searches furiously for Anton when it's revealed that he was abducted by the Skinner.

videos.title: Go Your Own Way
videos.overview: A series of chess-like moves ensues when Dexter and Miguel vie for the upper hand, with Miguel winning Rita's affection by presenting her with a lavish wedding gift; Debra wonders if her relationship with Anton is worth the trouble.

videos.title: I Had a Dream
videos.overview: Dexter must find a way to get rid of Miguel despite the fact that his friend is a highly placed district attorney and also Dexter's best man, and Debra finds a new clue to the Skinner's identity.

videos.title: Do You Take Dexter Morgan?
videos.overview: Dexter attempts to calm the unstable Ramon now that Miguel is out of the picture; Debra is about to receive her detective's shield but is blind-sided with information that could derail her promotion.

videos.title: Living the Dream
videos.overview: Dexter sleeplessly struggles to balance his new family life with his dark, murderous drive for a fresh victim, and his busier-than-ever forensic career pursuing a new target, "The Trinity Killer."

videos.title: Remains to Be Seen
videos.overview: Dexter realizes that he has carelessly misplaced crucial evidence that could expose his dark side to the world, while helping to investigate new slayings that Agent Frank Lundy insists are the work of Trinity.

videos.title: Blinded by the Light
videos.overview: Dexter is hampered by his neighborhood's increased vigilance due to vandalism, his temporary inability to drive himself anywhere, and his admiration for the killing technique of the artful Trinity Killer.

videos.title: Dex Takes a Holiday
videos.overview: Rita goes to a wedding with the kids, allowing Dexter to have his own little vacation. He does what he does best when alone, hunt, and goes after an officer with a dark secret.

videos.title: Dirty Harry
videos.overview: Dexter is inspired to investigate the Trinity Killer on his own, while Debra blames herself for an event that was out of her control, and Rita realizes how little she knows her husband after discovering one of his secrets.

videos.title: If I Had a Hammer
videos.overview: Dexter doubles his efforts to stay ahead of the official Trinity investigation, and receives relationship advice about the friction between himself and Rita from a most unexpected source.

videos.title: Slack Tide
videos.overview: Dexter finally strikes a balance between family, career and his secret life, but is thwarted in his pursuit of his next victim, while Debra expresses a renewed and unwelcome interest in their father's checkered past. Miami Metro Homicide tries to solve the Model Killer Case.

videos.title: Road Kill
videos.overview: Dexter wonders if his father's Code is truly the right path, and hopes to get answers by accompanying Trinity on an out-of-town road trip to Tampa; Debra discovers that her single-minded pursuit of Trinity has blinded her to the true identity of her assailant.

videos.title: Hungry Man
videos.overview: Dexter learns more about Arthur's bizarre and twisted world, while Rita has her hands full preparing Thanksgiving dinner for a full house, Debra uses the holiday to further investigate Trinity, and Batista gets closure on an old case.

videos.title: Lost Boys
videos.overview: The disappearance of a ten-year-old boy forces Dexter to question his assumptions about Trinity, while Cody defends one of Dexter's lies and Masuka is unable to face what he witnessed on Thanksgiving.

videos.title: Hello, Dexter Morgan
videos.overview: Dexter must buy time to protect himself when Debra's investigation brings the department one step away from identifying Arthur as the Trinity Killer; Rita confides in Dexter, but is disappointed in the result.

videos.title: The Getaway
videos.overview: Dexter and Arthur are on a collision course.

videos.title: My Bad
videos.overview: Dexter must make a choice; Quinn stirs up trouble for Dexter but supports Deb.

videos.title: Hello, Bandit
videos.overview: Dexter tries to focus on the children and fight his dark urges; Debra ends up on Quinn's doorstep.

videos.title: Practically Perfect
videos.overview: Dexter hires a nanny; Debra is annoyed with her new partner; Quinn continues to investigate Rita's murder.

videos.title: Beauty and the Beast
videos.overview: Dexter must save a life; Deb has a confrontation with a key suspect; Quinn follows up on the similarities between Dexter and Kyle Butler.

videos.title: First Blood
videos.overview: Dexter is saddled with an unwanted conspirator; Dexter worries about how Rita's death will affect Harrison; Deb works alone; Quinn enlists an old friend's help.

videos.title: Everything Is Illumenated
videos.overview: Dexter is drawn into a precarious situation; Batista discovers an interesting lead; Quinn gets information about Dexter from a questionable source.

videos.title: Circle Us
videos.overview: Dexter is called to investigate a horrifying crime scene; the Santa Muerte case leads to a violent standoff between Debra and the Santa Muerte killers.

videos.title: Take It!
videos.overview: Dexter and Lumen vet and stalk a violent killer; Debra gets into some unexpected trouble from the fallout of the Santa Muerte case

videos.title: Teenage Wasteland
videos.overview: Dexter and Lumen hunt for their next victim; Debra uncovers new evidence in the Barrel Girl case

videos.title: In the Beginning
videos.overview: Homicide uncovers some key evidence linked to one of Dexter's and Lumen's prior victims; Debra identifies two more suspects in the case.

videos.title: Hop a Freighter
videos.overview: Dexter must do damage control; Debra's speculation begins to take shape; Quinn becomes involved in a homicide.

videos.title: The Big One
videos.overview: Dexter realizes that he and Lumen are being lured into a trap and risks everything to escape; Quinn needs help that only Dexter can provide.

videos.title: Those Kinds of Things
videos.overview: An investigation into a faith-based murder causes Dexter to ask some spiritual questions; Debra becomes an unexpected hero.

videos.title: Once Upon a Time...
videos.overview: Brother Sam, a minister with a criminal history, is brought in by the homicide department to help solve a macabre murder, but Dexter sees him for what he really is, and it's definitely not a man of God. Elsewhere, Debra's sudden hero status elicits a pair of surprising proposals.

videos.title: Smokey and the Bandit
videos.overview: Dexter is confronted with a sobering glimpse of his own potential future when a serial killer from his past makes a startling reappearance; Debra is uncomfortable in her new job; Travis struggles to keep his mentor happy, as he and Gellar prepare a new twisted tableau, ensuring Debra's next task will be a daunting one.

videos.title: A Horse of a Different Color
videos.overview: Much to his own surprise, an emergency with Harrison and a new tableau from Gellar and Travis has Dexter leaning on Brother Sam and an unexpected winged messenger for support as he questions the idea of faith; with proof of a religiously motivated killer, Homicide hunts for a zealot, with Debra giving her first official press conference.

videos.title: The Angel of Death
videos.overview: With the help of his newfound friend Brother Sam, Dexter wonders if there is light within him to counter the darkness, while the search for the Doomsday Killers takes him in a new direction; Batista and Quinn pay a visit to the university where Professor Gellar taught; due to departmental regulations following the shooting, Debra is forced to begin therapy.

videos.title: Just Let Go
videos.overview: Dexter is caught up in a very personal case that awakens the needs of his Dark Passenger; Debra feels overwhelmed by her new Lieutenant duties, made all the more complicated when she finds out Quinn slept with a witness in the Doomsday case.

videos.title: Nebraska
videos.overview: Dexter finds himself teamed up with a fellow Dark Passenger when he takes a road trip to Nebraska to tie up some loose ends from the past; Debra deals with the complications of her promotion as she leads the Doomsday investigation.

videos.title: Sin of Omission
videos.overview: Dexter uses lessons he learned from Brother Sam to follow up on some new leads in the Doomsday investigation; Debra butts heads with Captain LaGuerta over the case of a dead call girl.

videos.title: Get Gellar
videos.overview: Dexter receives help from an unexpected source while hunting the Doomsday Killers and staying one step ahead of Homicide; Debra discovers something new about herself in therapy.

videos.title: Ricochet Rabbit
videos.overview: Dexter tries to figure out the Doomsday Killers' next victim before it's too late; Debra has a strong reaction to a crime scene, which leads her to the realization that she leans too heavily on her brother.

videos.title: Talk to the Hand
videos.overview: Dexter finds that in order to catch the Doomsday Killers, he must create a macabre tableau of his own; Debra's battle with LaGuerta over the case of the dead call girl boils over, and her therapist makes an unnerving suggestion.

videos.title: This Is the Way the World Ends
videos.overview: Dexter and Homicide race against a lunar eclipse to catch the Doomsday Killers before their final gruesome act; Debra struggles with a new emotional reality.

videos.title: Are You...?
videos.overview: After witnessing her brother kill, Debra attempts to reconcile with Dexter while struggling to cover up their involvement with the murder.

videos.title: Sunshine and Frosty Swirl
videos.overview: Miami Metro sets out to unearth new evidence on a claim from a local convict that he has new information regarding a 15-year-old crime spree; Debra tries to cure Dexter of his killer tendencies.

videos.title: Buck the System
videos.overview: Dexter tries to bring Debra on board with his new target. While the Ukrainian mob seeks revenge for the killing of one of their own, Quinn grows close to a dancer at their strip club.

videos.title: Run
videos.overview: After capturing a deadly killer, things go awry for Miami Metro, sending Debra into a tailspin. In an effort to help his sister, Dexter enters into a dangerous game of cat and mouse, while the Ukrainian mob continues to seek revenge.

videos.title: Swim Deep
videos.overview: While trying to uncover why someone was killed on his boat, Dexter must out-maneuver a vengeful Isaak. New leads are brought to light on the Wayne Randall case by Hannah McKay, Randall's alluring former accomplice who Dexter discovers has a secret.

videos.title: Do the Wrong Thing
videos.overview: Debra gets to know a local crime writer who's dug up some incriminating dirt on Hannah McKay. Quinn gets an offer he tries to refuse and Batista is drawn to a new business opportunity. LaGuerta keeps digging into the Bay Harbor Butcher case.

videos.title: Chemistry
videos.overview: Quinn falls back into his old ways as he makes some questionable choices to protect Nadia. Things heat up as Dexter and Hannah grow closer, but when Sal Price discovers the two are involved, he wants the exclusive story.

videos.title: Argentina
videos.overview: Fresh out of jail, Isaak renews his pursuit of Dexter while Quinn continues his power struggle with the Koshkas. Dexter tries to keep Debra in the dark about his relationship with Hannah, but a surprise visit from Astor, Cody and Harrison throws a wrench into his plans.

videos.title: Helter Skelter
videos.overview: As Dexter scrambles to track down Isaak, a power struggle erupts among the Koshka Brotherhood, which could prove to Dexter's advantage. Meanwhile, Miami Dade tries to smoke out the Phantom Arsonist.

videos.title: The Dark... Whatever
videos.overview: Dexter is unnerved when Hannah's father pays him a surprise visit; the Phantom Arsonist's crimes become more vicious; and Quinn defends Nadia's honor and finds himself in a volatile situation. Meanwhile; LaGuerta asks a former superior for help on the Bay Harbor Butcher case.

videos.title: Do You See What I See?
videos.overview: As Christmas approaches, Dexter tries to balance his life with Hannah and his relationship with Debra.

videos.title: Surprise, Motherfucker!
videos.overview: Dexter must protect himself when LaGuerta closes in on his secret.

videos.title: A Beautiful Day
videos.overview: It's been 6 months since the tragic events of Season 7's finale unveiled – Debra now works as a PI for a private firm and Batista has replaced her as Lieutenant. While Dexter is still managing life as a dad, brother, and serial killer. Miami Metro is investigating the murder of a man who has had pieces of his brain removed.

videos.title: Every Silver Lining...
videos.overview: Miami Metro continues their hunt for The Brain Surgeon, while Dr. Vogel enlists Dexter's help. Debra continues to track down her PI case and has to take matters into her own hands.

videos.title: What's Eating Dexter Morgan?
videos.overview: Dexter continues his manhunt for The Brain Surgeon. Dr. Vogel tries to prove to Dexter that he’s perfect as a psychopath. While Debra’s PTSD kicks in and her guilt from the past begins to creep up.

videos.title: Scar Tissue
videos.overview: Dexter tracks down another potential serial killer from Dr. Vogel’s list. Quinn celebrates his passing of the Sergeant’s exam by defending Debra’s honor in a fight. Dr. Vogel begins treating Debra for her PTSD.

videos.title: This Little Piggy
videos.overview: Dr. Vogel comes into contact with The Brain Surgeon. So Dexter and Debra come together to try and keep her safe.

videos.title: A Little Reflection
videos.overview: Dexter monitors a troubled young man. Dexter and Debra finally get back to normal.

videos.title: Dress Code
videos.overview: Dexter begins mentoring Zach to pass on the Code, attempting to shape the boy's dark urges into a disciplined outlet for his instincts.

videos.title: Are We There Yet?
videos.overview: Dexter tracks down Zach, concerned that he may have murdered an innocent person. Meanwhile, Dexter tries to help Hannah escape the country.

videos.title: Make Your Own Kind of Music
videos.overview: Dexter investigates a murder that hits close to home. Meanwhile, Dr. Vogel gets the surprise of her life when someone from her past returns.

videos.title: Goodbye Miami
videos.overview: Dexter enlists Dr. Vogel's help to lure The Brain Surgeon to a location in order to get him on the table.

videos.title: Monkey in a Box
videos.overview: Dexter is torn trying to choose between fleeing the country to go to Argetina with Hannah and Harrison or taking out The Brain Surgeon once and for all.

videos.title: Remember the Monsters?
videos.overview: Dexter is faced with impossible odds as a brewing hurricane makes its way towards Miami.

awards: Won 4 Primetime Emmys. 56 wins & 202 nominations total
